entities.summary: Bahman Jalali was an Iranian photographer who played a significant role in educating a new generation of Iranian photographers such as Shadi Ghadirian, Peyman Hooshmandzadeh, Hasan Sarbakhshian Mehdi Vosoughnia and ext. He taught photography at several universities in Iran over a 30-year period.
